machine.text: Run commands on your own computer, with its programs and servers, such as a site’s dev server. JavaScript and Python stay in the sandbox.
machine.on: Tasks with the folder {folder} run their commands on this computer, each asked first, until you press Ctrl+C in its terminal.
machine.question: Run this on your computer, in {folder}?
machine.app: Commands can also run on this computer, with its own programs and servers, in a folder you choose: tasks with that folder then run their commands there.
machine.failed: It didn’t start: it needs Node.js on this computer, the node command a terminal runs.
machine.on.app: Tasks with the folder {folder} run their commands on this computer, each asked first.
machine.lede: Tasks use the sandbox, except those in the folder you connect on this computer.
machine.step.open: Open a terminal in one of your folders.
machine.step.paste: Paste this line there, then press Enter.
machine.step.wait: Waiting for the line to run: this page notices by itself.
